note: Edge enters graph only if source supports RELATIONSHIP itself. Verified = both rounds agree with relationship evidence. Disputed = rounds disagree or directional-only. Quarantined edges in quarantine.csv, NOT here.

edges.evidence: BIS WP1083 (negative assoc, strongest for Cu/tin); CME 2026-06-30 mechanical denomination. Nodes verified (FRED/ECB), beta not quantified.
edges.mechanism: Stronger dollar makes dollar-priced copper mechanically dearer for non-US buyers, denting demand.
edges.status_note: R1-quarantine (nodes only) vs R2-quarantine; keep as Disputed directional, NOT quantified beta.

edges.direction: TC collapse -> custom smelter cuts -> refined supply down
edges.evidence: Reuters Jun-2026 + MiningWeekly Nov-2025 + CRU 2026: $80+8c (2024)->$21.25+2.125c (2025)->$0/t 2026 (Jiangxi/Antofagasta); spot negative; >10% China 2026 cuts; ICSG +0.9% refined. IEA commentary corroborates.
edges.mechanism: Zero processing margin forces custom smelters to cut/close, capping refined output.
edges.sign: positive (tightness up -> supply down -> price up)

edges.direction: LME Cu high -> scrap collection up -> secondary supply up -> deficit dampened
edges.evidence: ETC factsheet (high prices incentivise recycling); IEA (expanding recycling on high prices); ICSG secondary +5.7% vs primary +2.3%. Elasticity magnitude not evidenced.
edges.mechanism: Record Cu incentivises collection + feed switch to scrap (TC-free), partly offsetting concentrate gap.

edges.direction: Tariff expectation -> COMEX-LME spread wide -> physical diverted to US -> non-US tightness
edges.evidence: SocGen via FXStreet 10-Aug-2026 tariff-arbitrage reshapes spread; StoneX 4-way ruling; Benchmark exclusion nuance; ING/CNBC 200kt/mo US imports, COMEX record stocks at LME/SHFE expense.
edges.mechanism: Phased-tariff expectation widens COMEX premium, pulling metal to US and draining LME/SHFE.

edges.direction: China PMI/output soft -> global Cu demand soft -> price/premia soft
edges.evidence: NBS PMI 50.1 Sep-2026 vs 49.8 Aug; Reuters/Mining.com copper slides as China data weighs. Event co-move only, no beta.
edges.mechanism: China ~58-60% refined use; sub-50 PMI maps to cathode/rod order cuts and SHFE builds.

edges.direction: Cu/Al ratio high -> Al substitution -> Cu demand shaved
edges.evidence: Cu/Al 4.2-4.4 Jan-2026 (FinancialContent/FT); 3.5-4.0x threshold triggers switch (CRU/JPM); IEA Al-for-Cu saves up to 3.6Mt by 2040; Prysmian/auto cases.
edges.mechanism: At >3.5-4x, cable/winding/EV qualify aluminium, shaving copper demand.

edges.evidence: RBI/FBIL + ECB ref rates + CBIC tariff values; CablePriceIndia formula. Identity, no econometrics needed.
edges.mechanism: Rs/kg = LME $/t /1000 x USD/INR x (1+duty/freight/margin). 1% INR slip ~= Rs10-13/kg at $13-14k/t.

edges.direction: Rates up -> construction/manufacturing soft -> brass demand soft
edges.evidence: JPM (Cu extremely sensitive to growth/construction); CME (rising rates curtail expansion). No Castle-specific elasticity.
edges.mechanism: Higher rates curtail building/auto/grid capex to which brass demand is geared.

edges.direction: Oil/Red Sea disruption -> freight up -> INR landed up
edges.evidence: JPM Red Sea (30% via Suez, Asia-Europe ~5x, lagged pass-through); Descartes/Hormuz surcharges; Drewry WCI route legs (URL re-verify).
edges.mechanism: $100+/bbl + Cape detour (+8-12d) + war-risk/ETS lifts Asia-Europe spot, passing to imports.
